title: feat(leaveax): leave-axis restores k=7 reverse: t=15 vs t=25
science: Introduces the leave-axis hop-cost lambda = nu + cost 3 on every 1->2 support-rise, and restores same-k reverse at k=7 on B_21 (t(7,0,0)=15 vs t(7,7,7)=25, 675>625) where nu fails (13 vs 23, 507<529). The runner's whyk7 walk decomposition [3,3,1,1,1,1,1,1,3]=15 pins exactly which hop the new clause repriced.
